forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's governing coalition lose its Knesset majority (below 61 seats) or dissolve early — with the election date moving before 2026-10-27 — before the scheduled election date?
forecasts.delta_reason: Knesset dissolved naturally on July 17, 2026, completing a full four-year term — the first such completion since 1988. The coalition held 61 seats at dissolution. Both YES branches evaluated: (1) no roll-call vote confirming loss of majority occurred; (2) no early dissolution with election date moving before Oct 27 — the election remained scheduled for Oct 27. Natural term dissolution is not early dissolution. RESOLVED-NO. Judge overrides Analyst RETIRE-OBE; DA RESOLVE-YES rejected — the criteria require the election date to move earlier than Oct 27, which did not occur. F5 covers the live electoral question.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Natural Knesset dissolution at end of full four-year term does not satisfy the early dissolution criterion. The election date must move to a date earlier than Oct 27 to trigger YES. A confidence vote survived = NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

indicators.name: Knesset roll-call vote confirming coalition below 61 seats
Netanyahu formal early-election announcement with election date before Oct 27

forecasts.graveyard_reason: Knesset dissolved naturally Jul 17 at end of full four-year term; coalition held 61 seats at dissolution; election date remained Oct 27, not earlier; neither YES branch triggered; RESOLVE-NO confirmed by Judge; DA RESOLVE-YES rejected.

forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
forecasts.delta_reason: No evidence of a public Iranian commitment to mediated ceasefire negotiations by EOD Sep 6. Trump waved off the idea of a deal on September 2 and the US halted envoy contacts on August 18. Iran's SNSC secretary Rezaei stated around September 15 that no negotiations until Iran's conditions are met. Conditional or preconditioned postures trigger the ambiguity_rule → RESOLVE-AS-NO. Past horizon; resolved.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, Supreme National Security Council, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States. A 'readiness for talks' declaration counts; mere written-message relay does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Araghchi or SNSC public statement committing to talks before Sep 6
Oman or Qatar mediator readout citing named Iranian acceptance before Sep 6

forecasts.question: Will a confirmed Iran-US indirect negotiating session (mediated, senior officials, named principals) occur before EOD 2026-09-17?
forecasts.delta_reason: No confirmed indirect Iran-US negotiating session occurred before EOD Sep 17. The first confirmed session was Qatar-mediated shuttle diplomacy at UNGA in New York on September 22-23 — five days after the horizon — with Araghchi and Witkoff named as principals. Trump halted envoy contacts August 18; Iran's SNSC chief stated no talks without preconditions as of approximately September 15; active US-Iran kinetic exchange September 1-2 further hardened positions. Past horizon; resolved.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session (not mere message relay) between named US and Iranian senior officials/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar/Switzerland), between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-17.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official mediator readout.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Message relay through intermediaries without a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Trump assertions of 'semi-negotiating' without Iranian or mediator confirmation of a held session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Oman/Qatar/Pakistan mediator readout of a convened session before Sep 17
Iran MFA confirms re-engagement or talks readiness before Sep 17
US-Iran bilateral halt in strikes for 72h+ (precondition)

forecasts.question: Will commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz reach >=30 vessels/day (7-day rolling average) before EOD 2026-10-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: Shipping data as of September 23-24 records 3 and 10 commercial transits respectively, with the 10-day moving average at approximately 15-17 vessels — less than half the ≥30 target. Commercial vessels were struck by projectiles on September 23, resulting in fires and casualties. AIS tracking shows 223 vessels holding position outside the strait watch box as of late September, waiting for conditions to change. Only 5 calendar days remain to the October 3 horizon; reaching a 7-day rolling average of ≥30 requires sustained tripling of traffic against continued Iranian attack activity, active mine threat, prohibitive war-risk premiums, and no Hormuz commitment from UNGA talks. Underlying probability is approximately 0.04; p set to schema floor 0.05.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if any AIS-based ship-tracking source (IMF PortWatch, Straits.live, MarineTraffic, Lloyd's List Intelligence) records >=30 commercial transits/day as a 7-day rolling average at any point between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-03.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: AIS-based tracker + one TIER1 or OSINT confirmation (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval escort vessels and warships do not count toward commercial transit; if trackers diverge by >20%, flag AMBIGUOUS.

indicators.name: Sustained 72h halt in Iranian mine/vessel-attack activity
P&I war-risk cover reinstated by a named insurer for Hormuz passage
CENTCOM or mediator-confirmed Iranian commitment to halt mine deployment

forecasts.question: Will Likud win the most Knesset seats (seat plurality) in the October 27, 2026 Israeli election?
forecasts.delta_reason: Five Knesset seat polls published September 23-27 give Yashar (Eisenkot) a seat advantage in three of five surveys: Kan 11 (Sep 27) Yashar 23 / Likud 21; Channel 13 (Sep 24) gives Eisenkot bloc 52 vs Netanyahu bloc 51; Channel 12 (Sep 23) Yashar 23 / Likud 20. Channel 14 and i24NEWS give Likud a clear advantage. Smotrich's Religious Zionism recorded a new polling high in a September 27 survey, compressing Likud's right-flank supply. Polling average has moved Yashar-ward since Sep 3. Judge settles at p=0.35, acknowledging the Yashar-ward trend while preserving upward weight for two Likud-favorable polls and extreme inter-poll variance with 29 days remaining.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if official Knesset election results published by the Israeli Central Elections Committee show Likud winning more seats than any other single party in the October 27, 2026 election.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Israeli Central Elections Committee official results, carried by Times of Israel/Haaretz/Reuters/AP.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If Likud and one other party tie on seats: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO (no plurality). Exit polls alone do not resolve; official preliminary results suffice if published before EOD Oct 27.

indicators.name: Polls showing Likud >=23 seats, ahead of Yashar
Likud bloc forms coalition-eligible alliance pre-election

forecasts.question: Will a confirmed indirect Iran-US negotiating session (mediator-convened, named principals) occur before EOD 2026-10-01?
forecasts.delta_reason: Trump told Axios on September 28 he expects talks with Iran to resume as early as Monday (today); CBS News and Yahoo report indirect talks could occur this week. Iran's Foreign Ministry countered the same day that none are planned. The conflicting public signals place this near 40%: enough US-side push that a session is plausible even against Iranian public denials, but insufficient Iranian buy-in to make it probable.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a mediator-convened indirect negotiating session between named US envoys and named Iranian officials occurring at any venue, with a named mediator, before EOD 2026-10-01. The same session-quality threshold as F3 applies: face-to-face or formally convened; message relay alone does not qualify.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera/NYT) OR one TIER1 plus official mediator readout.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Message relay only without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A Trump or Iranian official statement that 'talks are happening' without a confirmed session description = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A mediator readout confirming 'discussions' without a named venue or date = AMBIGUOUS.

indicators.name: Qatar or Oman mediator readout of a convened session
Iran MFA confirms session or travel of Araghchi to mediation venue

forecasts.question: Will Iran and the United States mutually announce any agreed ceasefire or brief truce (defined as >=48-hour confirmed bilateral halt in US and Iranian strikes) before EOD 2026-10-20?
forecasts.delta_reason: Iran presented a 60-day ceasefire roadmap at UNGA (Pezeshkian Sep 22-26); Trump rejected it Sep 26, calling it terms 'maybe agreed to a year ago,' while telling aides he expects to resume bombing after November midterms. The October 1-20 window falls before that threshold, creating a narrow diplomatic lane. Pezeshkian stated September 26 that 'the process will begin from the very day they accept.' The gap between Iran's full-package demand (end to all US actions, blockade, frozen assets) and Trump's narrower framing is wide. Gulf mediators (Qatar, Oman) remain active. P=0.18 reflects that a deal is possible but requires bridging a large structural gap in 22 days while Trump's calculus runs against committing before November.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if both US and Iranian officials publicly confirm a mutual ceasefire or truce with a named start date and duration >=48 hours, before EOD 2026-10-20. A unilateral Iranian announcement not accepted by the US does NOT resolve YES. A de facto lull without official joint announcement does NOT resolve YES.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two TIER1 sources carrying both US and Iranian official confirmation, OR one TIER1 + official mediator readout. Trump social media alone without State/CENTCOM confirmation does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If one side announces and the other does not confirm within 24h: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. If terms are publicly contested between the two sides: AMBIGUOUS.
